methodology.label: Status & scope
methodology.text: Placeholder fixture. No benchmark has been published here. Every numerical result is n/e. The frozen EnterpriseRAG-derived subset is synthetic and English, with incomplete relevance labels and context loss; it cannot establish production performance.

methodology.label: Subset derivation
methodology.text: Frozen: 250 of the core 500 questions, stratified by official type using Hamilton allocation and stable SHA-256 selection. All selected gold documents plus source-proportional distractors make 20,000 documents. 379 gold documents; 96,402,403 corpus bytes. Seed: fyrr-compare-v1-2026-11-16. The separate 10-question / 1,000-document smoke test is never a published benchmark. Exact freeze and protocol hashes are recorded below.

methodology.label: Shared answer & judge
methodology.text: Secondary track, after retrieval and latency: one literal question, no rewriting or iterative retrieval. Top 10 unique documents, at most 4,000 Unicode characters each. Shared generation and judging through the ChatGPT subscription; exact planned models are recorded in protocol metadata below. Native answers needing an LLM API key are n/e.

methodology.label: Embeddings
methodology.text: Planned: Voyage voyage-4 with 1,024 dimensions for every product that supports it. A system using its recommended default instead must be flagged. Actual model verification, dimensions and per-product settings: n/e.

methodology.label: Uncertainty & missing results
methodology.text: 95% percentile bootstrap intervals: 10,000 resamples, seed 1729, paired question IDs. Expected is the frozen denominator; attempted counts actual attempts; n counts valid results; missing = expected minus n, including unattempted rows. Retrieval excludes 15 empty-gold questions, leaving 235. Incomplete answer aggregates are partial. Unequal successful subsets cannot establish a product win.

methodology.label: Speed protocol
methodology.text: Primary: ask each of the 250 questions once per fresh service at concurrency 1 and 8, after one unrelated index warm-up. Fresh query caches; embedding-provider time included; percentile bootstrap intervals. Repeated-query warm timings remain a separate secondary track. Timed runs require a quiet host.

methodology.label: Hardware, versions & measurement date
methodology.text: No completed product measurement yet. Recorded versions and resolved configurations appear in each run JSON below; missing hardware, binary hashes and measurement dates remain n/e. Run metadata alone is not a benchmark result.

methodology.label: Cost assumptions
methodology.text: Reference scenario: 730 hours per month, one node, 20,000 documents, 100,000 searches and 1% of documents updated daily. Separate recurring hosting, variable API charges and one-time ingestion. Unit prices need dated sources. No estimate until all inputs are known.

methodology.label: Headline wording
methodology.text: Headline clauses are evaluated separately on complete comparable measurements. Search quality refers to recall@10 versus the strongest alternative: comparable is a descriptive label when the gap is at most 2 percentage points or the 95% intervals overlap, with the measured gap shown; it is not an equivalence test. Query speed uses first-ask C1 medians; ingest uses accepted-document wall time. A fraction of running cost requires a complete stated model and at most half the least expensive alternative’s estimated monthly cost. Missing evidence produces a pending statement, not a win.
